Use one of {{artworkCount}} illustrations for a Singapore country report or a Southeast Asia map key. A larger upper corner makes it easier for students to count all five stars.

editorial.intro: Find Monaco flag clipart with a red band over white, including flat cloth flags, waving fabric and line drawings.
paragraphs: Two fields of color are enough to identify the Monaco flag clipart in this gallery. A straight red over white flag shows the division clearly, while folded cloth and wider scenes show how the flag can sit in a composition.
Use one of the {{artworkCount}} illustrations to label Monaco on a small map. A plain flag works where space is limited, and a cloth view adds shape to a personal trip page.

editorial.intro: Explore Irish flag clipart with green, white and orange tricolors in flat flags, folded fabric and outline drawings.
paragraphs: The green and orange panels sit on either side of white in this Irish flag clipart. Straight views keep that order visible, while the fabric and illustrated displays give the same three colors different shapes on the page.

Choose a flag from {{artworkCount}} illustrations for an Ireland country study or a personal travel journal. The flat designs fit well next to short place labels where there is little room for scenery.

editorial.intro: Explore Liechtenstein flag clipart with a gold crown on blue and red, including sewn fabric and outline drawings.
paragraphs: Look to the upper corner of the Liechtenstein flag clipart for the gold crown. Flat fabric makes it easy to pick out the crown and the two colored fields, while folded versions add depth around the emblem.
Among {{artworkCount}} illustrations, use a large crown view for a flag symbol study or a simple cloth flag for a geography card about Liechtenstein and its Alpine neighbors.
